guide.title: Import guide
guide.step1_title: Install the skill in your ChatGPT or Claude
guide.step2_body: Hand it a PDF, image, spreadsheet or CSV and say "turn this into a wallet import CSV." It'll output a CSV file or a code block.
guide.step2_privacy_hint: Your statement only ever goes through your own chat tool — it never touches this app's server.
guide.blank_category_hint: Leave the category code blank rather than guessing — blank rows get flagged "uncategorized" in review so you can decide yourself
guide.error_retry: The import format didn't load — try again

upload.title: New import
upload.source_hint: Rows with a blank currency will be recorded in {{currency}}
upload.dropzone_hint: Choose the CSV your skill generated (2 MB max)
upload.guide_link: How do I generate this file?
upload.non_csv_hint: Upload the CSV your skill generated — for PDFs, images or spreadsheets, have your ChatGPT/Claude convert them first

error.copy_hint: Paste this back into your ChatGPT/Claude and have it fix the file
error.skill_outdated_body: Your skill is {{fileVersion}}, but the app is now on {{currentVersion}} — the category table changed. Update your skill and regenerate this file.
error.go_to_guide: Update the skill in the import guide →
error.file_too_large: The file is larger than 2 MB. A month's statement is usually only a few dozen KB — make sure you uploaded a CSV, not a raw PDF.
error.rows_exceed_limit: This file has {{rows}} rows, over the 2000-row-per-batch limit — have the skill split it by month.
error.rate_limited: You've used up this hour's imports (10). Try again later.

review.title: {{filename}} → {{source}}

bulk.mixed_kind_error: Row {{row}} is a {{kind}} row and doesn't match this category — nothing in this batch was changed
bulk.failed: Nothing in this batch was changed — check the selected rows

linked.transfer_pair_confirm: Found the other side on that account — link it as one transfer?
linked.transfer_pair_hint: Pairing will unify both legs onto the same subtype
linked.transfer_multi_hint: Found {{count}} transfers that could be paired — pick one
linked.transfer_already_paired: The other side is already paired with something else

review.hint_duplicate_row: There's an identical row in this batch (row {{row}})
review.block_uncategorized_one: {{count}} row still needs a category before you can submit
review.block_uncategorized_other: {{count}} rows still need a category before you can submit
review.submit_pairs_hint_one: {{count}} transfer pair will be merged into {{count}} transaction
review.submit_pairs_hint_other: {{count}} transfer pairs will be merged into {{count}} transactions
review.mobile_default_filter_hint: On mobile, it's usually easiest to finish the uncategorized rows here and handle the rest on a computer
review.error_retry: This import didn't load — try again
review.block_incomplete_one: {{count}} row still has no date, amount or currency
review.block_incomplete_other: {{count}} rows still have no date, amount or currency
review.block_all_skipped: Every row in this batch is skipped — keep at least one to submit
review.block_rows_loading: {{rows}} more rows are still loading — you can submit once they are here
review.block_failed_saves: {{rows}} edits failed to save (from row {{row}}) — retry them before submitting

keyboard.edit: Edit this cell; while editing, save and move down
keyboard.cancel: Cancel the edit and restore the original

committed.summary: Imported {{created}} transactions ({{pairs}} paired transfers created together, {{paired}} paired with an existing transfer, {{refunds}} linked to an original expense, {{skipped}} rows skipped)
committed.undo_confirm_body: This will delete the {{count}} transactions this import created and remove this import record. This can't be undone.
committed.undo_orphaned_refunds_one: {{count}} refund outside this batch points to an expense in it — after deleting, it will become a refund with no original expense (the refund itself is kept).
committed.undo_orphaned_refunds_other: {{count}} refunds outside this batch point to expenses in it — after deleting, they will become refunds with no original expense (the refunds themselves are kept).
committed.undo_refunds_in_batch_one: This batch has {{count}} refund — deleting it will restore the refundable balance on the expense it reduced.
committed.undo_refunds_in_batch_other: This batch has {{count}} refunds — deleting them will restore the refundable balance on the expenses they reduced.
committed.summary_fallback: This import has been committed — {{rows}} rows

history.title: Import history
history.discard_confirm_body: This batch hasn't been submitted — discarding it deletes its {{count}} draft rows and leaves your existing transactions alone.
history.error_retry: The import history didn't load — try again

empty.title: No imports yet
empty.body: Have your ChatGPT/Claude turn a statement into a CSV, then bring it in here
